note: golive-unseen-gate2 (docs/222 §11, Rodney 2026-11-06 R1 + R3): default-ON gate for unseen-direct go-live. Old cadence / pushes / GoHome bars do not gate. Runs at pace 78. Read V6 (gate2-report.ts) after the 4 *-gu2-t-ab* jobs: V6 FAIL does not stop the queue, so stop it by hand, the later jobs would be at a pace about to change, and run golive-unseen-gate2-pace.json. Build first: see the 11-08 RELEASE GATE part at the end. Read: node tools/harness/gate2-report.ts golive-unseen-gate2-<date>. Trimmed 2026-11-06 (Rodney, §11.9): 31 to 27 jobs, the 4 *-gu2-fastspeed-ab and *-gu2-speed1-ab jobs are gone (read only by naming them, no bar, R1-R4 log rows); the *-gu2-x-* jobs carry the X4 bench (--ab fwnull --fixedwork 8), so run x4-smoke.json first. Audit=50 cost: no arm, gate2-report.ts reads ts3native cutAuditUs per arm (bar 0.5 ms/s, my judgement). | 11-08 night rules: stopQueueOnFail false (a non-crash FAIL goes on; a watcher stops the queue on a crash or an own-code hang); ip-gu2-focus last at 30 min. | 11-08 REST AT CREDIT: repinned to g2pair1108b (-gu100 package, runtime autunseenpacecredit,autseengame; the -rel arms stay on the release package); the jobs that PASSED on 11-07 (t-ab x4) and the focus/arrive jobs handled elsewhere (bp-gu2-focus PASS, arrive in gu2-arrive-rerun.json) are removed: 20 jobs left (x a1/b1/b2/a2 bp, kept so all 8 cross jobs run on one pair at credit, x ip x4, out x4, crowd, save x6, ip-gu2-focus on aut-unseen-focus-loop). Run gu2-arrive-rerun and the smoke first (queue.ts plans the smoke, the pair changed). | 11-08 RELEASE GATE ON master1108 (Rodney): repinned to the combined pair master1108 (asi + fixesPackage + pinReason; CasTrim pins dropped, 0.36.211 has CasTrim, repo ini defaults apply). Needs before the run: ts3fixes.package.master1108-gu100 (pace 100) and master1108-rel (kAutLive False) built from master 896c0e8b, and ts3agent.package.master1108 (focus_watch, save_game/load_save) via TS3_AGENT_PACKAGE. Save checks folded: the 6 *-gu2-save-* jobs are gone; bp/ip/sv-gu2-out-on-save run aut-live-save-reload (same steps, earlyGates, logRequire) in the out-on load (reuseSession on both: the out-on window is the first of its load, unchanged; out-off has none so it never shares), one per world; sv-gu2-out-on added for that. Out-off kept: no earlier same-seed out-off run exists (no *-out-off-activity.jsonl in probe-out/profile; the 11-07 queue stopped before the out jobs), so gate2-report.ts §11.3 has nothing else to compare with. 18 jobs, 322 run min (was 20 jobs, 334 min; sv-gu2-out-on adds 30).
